summary: community.aws deprecated support for Python versions below 3.8, following the AWS SDK support policy, with removal in release 10.0.0.
questions: When does community.aws drop Python older than 3.8?

answer_card.title: community.aws deprecates Python < 3.8
answer_card.answer_md: Because the AWS SDKs ended support for Python below 3.8, community.aws deprecated support for **Python < 3.8**, to be removed in release **10.0.0**.
